question: How is the divine lotus of the first octad described?
premises: The lotus has eight spokes or petals
It is adorned by the first octad
inference: The divine lotus is eight-spoked and adorned by the first octad.
uncertainties: āraṃ can suggest spokes; in lotus imagery it may imply petals
plain_english: It is a divine eight-spoked lotus, adorned by the first octad.
